t: GitHub - snap-research/qfar: Official implementation of MobiCom 2023 paper "QfaR: Location-Guided Scanning of Visual Codes from Long Distances"
QfaR: Location-Guided Scanning of Visual Codes from Long Distances
s: Visual codes such as QR codes provide a low-cost and convenient communication channel between physical objects and mobile devices, but typically operate when the code and the device are in close physical proximity. We propose a system, called QfaR, which enables mobile devices to scan visual codes across long distances even where the image resolution of the visual codes is extremely low.
